claims.text: POL-NS-01 is drafted conjunctively and limb (c) fails on the driver's own telemetry. The required continuous in-geofence dwell for a LARGE_VENUE pickup is 300 seconds under fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec, and the longest qualifying run in the driver's trace is 130 seconds, from 08:10:50 to 08:13:00 (14 fixes). Limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' event, so the 170-second shortfall is the whole of the case: where limb (c) fails the fee 'is not chargeable under this clause'.

POL-NS-06 decides the consequence and it is a full refund, not a discount. The effective in-geofence dwell of 130 seconds is shorter than the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full — 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The measured shortfall is 170 seconds, and fare_breakdown shows the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line charged and unrefunded, which is the line to be refunded (and only that line).

The driver cannot rescue the shortfall by summing separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i). First, the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for limb (i) to add to the first. Second, limb (i) additionally requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of an admissible type covering the pickup road. EV-ADVIS-00603-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0; its absence is itself citable and establishes that no advisory covers this road in this window, so limb (i) is unavailable and cannot be asserted to extend the clock.

Arrival is not the contest here. Even taking the driver's arrival under POL-NS-02 as made out — the trace does contain qualifying in-radius fixes — POL-NS-02 itself provides that where qualifying in-radius fixes exist 'this clause is satisfied and the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01 limb (c)'. On that dwell the driver fails by 170 seconds. Arriving at the pin is not the same as holding position there for the period the fee is consideration for, and the rider's entitlement follows from the shortfall alone.

The driver's own record contradicts his explanation. He says the rider took 'more like five' minutes; the trip record shows wait_time_min 2.3, and the trace shows a total in-geofence dwell of 130 seconds terminated by his cancellation at 08:13:10. His assertion that he 'cancelled within my rights' and had 'another booking queued' does not meet any limb of POL-NS-01 — in particular it does not answer limb (c), which is a numeric test on the trace, not a matter of the driver's convenience.

The rider's own track corroborates her account that she was on her way down and was visible when the driver left: EV-GPS-00603 places her device at 32.6-40.6 m from the pickup pin across 17 qualifying fixes running from 08:10:40 to 08:13:04, comfortably inside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m that POL-NS-04(c) sets for a LARGE_VENUE, and the driver's answered 22-second in-app call at 08:11:00 shows the parties were in contact. I do not put the refund on POL-NS-04 — the refund follows from the dwell shortfall — but the rider's proximity rebuts any suggestion that she was absent or unreachable.

No driver compensation can attach. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'. POL-NS-01 is not satisfied — limb (c) fails by 170 seconds — and POL-NS-06 expressly provides that on a shortfall 'the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable'. None of the SGD 4.00 may therefore be routed to the driver, and the anti-farming guard in POL-NS-07 is never reached.

The amount to be refunded is fixed by the record, not by assertion. The contested line is the cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in EV-FARE-00603, and it reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so a FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.00 returns the entirety of the contested amount to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

This is a clean bundle and should be decided, not escalated. There is no impairment under POL-NS-08: the trace is 100% covered, max_gap_sec is 0.0 with 45 driver fixes, the chat log's zero messages are consistent with trip_record.chat_message_count 0, and the fare line reconciles under limb (d). There is no POL-NS-09 trigger: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 and 0. The only MISSING artifact is the advisory, which carries no fact and is not the sole evidence for the deciding fact — the dwell shortfall is carried by telemetry at weight_multiplier 1.0, above the 0.70 floor, so confidence is not capped.

claims.text: The driver arrived at the pickup point, and POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are both met. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:52, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of 120 m at or before that timestamp — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 08:10:50, two seconds ahead of the marker, with 14 qualifying fixes in the geofence. The POL-NS-02 proximity test is therefore satisfied, not failed.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is met on the face of the trip record: the record shows no boarding event and the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes that limb (d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT). This is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE case, so POL-NS-03 is not engaged.

The driver did not sit silent and let the clock run. He placed an in-app voice call at 08:11:00 which the rider answered for 22 seconds, recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls. Under POL-NS-04(b) a recorded in-app call placed before termination defeats the rider's exoneration clause outright, and independently limb (a) cannot be met because the chat log for this trip holds zero messages — there is no locating or coordinating message to point to.

The charge itself is arithmetically correct and there was no false arrival marker, so two of the rider-side attacks do not land. On POL-NS-08(d): SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), matching fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee exactly, so the ledger line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule. On POL-NS-05: at the arrival marker the driver was stationary inside the geofence, nowhere near 300 m out and travelling well under 15 km/h (his distinct speeds top out at 8.8 km/h), so the false-arrival limb does not fire and no false-arrival referral is warranted against him.

The driver does not dispute the dwell arithmetic, and I put it on the record rather than stretch it: his longest continuous in-geofence hold was 130 seconds against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, a shortfall of 170 seconds, which under POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-01(c) makes the cancellation-fee line refundable in full whether or not the rider was ready. The driver's submission is directed at the ground of decision, not the quantum: the only failing limb is (c), and the shortfall should not be recharacterised as a refused job — the telemetry shows a driver who arrived, held station and cancelled under the RIDER_NO_SHOW code, not one who abandoned the kerb.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute is decided on the driver's own telemetry, and the outcome is the same on either side's account of who was where.

A cancellation fee is chargeable only if all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold. Conditions (a), (b) and (d) do hold: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:52; EV-GPS-00603 places the driver inside the 120 m large-venue arrival radius from 08:10:50 with 14 qualifying in-geofence fixes, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met; and the trip was terminated by the driver under the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Condition (c) fails. For a LARGE_VENUE pickup the driver must hold position inside the geofence continuously for 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The longest continuous in-geofence hold in the trace is 130 seconds (08:10:50 to 08:13:00), a shortfall of 170 seconds; the trip record's own wait_time_min of 2.3 minutes is consistent with that. The shortfall cannot be made up by summing separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i): the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and EV-ADVIS-00603-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no qualifying traffic advisory exists to permit accumulation.

Because limb (c) fails, POL-NS-01 makes the fee not chargeable, and POL-NS-06 fixes the consequence as a full refund - expressly whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. That is the ruling, and the driver's advocate fairly conceded the arithmetic. The driver's explanation (five minutes, another booking queued) does not meet limb (c), which is a numeric test on the trace, not a matter of his convenience.

On the rider's further points: POL-NS-04 does not carry the case and is not needed. The driver placed an in-app voice call at 08:11:00, answered for 22 seconds, which defeats limb (b); and the chat log holds zero messages, so there is no locating or coordinating message for limb (a). The refund does not depend on that clause. The rider's own device track (32.6-40.6 m from the pin across 17 fixes, inside the 150 m large-venue presence radius) is consistent with her account of coming down, but it changes nothing, because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless.

On the driver's points: the charge itself is arithmetically correct - SGD 4.00 is the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so the fare line reconciles under POL-NS-08(d) and there is no integrity defect. No false-arrival marker fired: at the arrival timestamp the driver was stationary inside the geofence, well under 300 m from the pin and below 15 km/h (distinct speeds top out at 8.8 km/h), so POL-NS-05 does not apply and no false-arrival referral is recorded against him.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; limb (c) fails and POL-NS-06 expressly provides that on a shortfall no driver compensation is payable. The anti-farming guard is never reached, and no referral arises.

Amount: the contested line is the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in EV-FARE-00603, charged (payment_status CHARGED) and unrefunded (refund_issued_sgd 0.00). A full refund of SGD 4.00 returns the whole contested amount to the filing rider.

Confidence: the deciding fact - the 170-second dwell shortfall - is carried by EV-GPS-00603 and EV-TRIP-00603, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) show no impairment: no clock skew (arrival event 08:10:52 against a fix at 08:10:50), no trace gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 45 fixes), a chat log consistent with the record's count of 0, and a fare line that reconciles. The MISSING advisory carries weight 0.0 and can carry no fact, but it is not the evidence for the deciding fact. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor, and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies.

To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

A no-show fee stands only if all four conditions in POL-NS-01 hold. Three of them do, and the driver is right about that: the trip record carries his 'arrived' event at 08:10:52 (limb (a)); the GPS trace puts him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 08:10:50, two seconds ahead of that event, with 14 qualifying in-geofence fixes (limb (b)); and the trip was ended by the driver under the RIDER_NO_SHOW code with no boarding event (limb (d)). Limb (c) fails. A LARGE_VENUE pickup requires a continuous in-geofence hold of 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. His longest continuous hold was 130 seconds, from 08:10:50 to 08:13:00 — a shortfall of 170 seconds — and he cancelled at 08:13:10.

POL-NS-06 decides the consequence: where the effective dwell falls short of the POL-NS-01 minimum the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded. Neither qualification in that clause helps the driver. His trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for limb (i) to add; and limb (i) additionally requires a present, populated traffic advisory covering the pickup road, while EV-ADVIS-00603-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 — an absent artifact that supports no fact here. The driver's own submission in fact concedes the dwell arithmetic and asks only that it not be read as abandoning the job; I accept that characterisation, and it does not restore the fee.

Driver's arguments, answered together: he did arrive, he did hold station, the charge is arithmetically correct, and there was no false arrival marker. On POL-NS-08(d), SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so the fare line reconciles and shows no integrity defect. On POL-NS-05, at the arrival timestamp he was stationary inside the geofence — nowhere near the 300 m trigger — and his recorded speeds never exceed 8.8 km/h, so no false-arrival finding and no referral arises. All of that is accepted. None of it answers limb (c): five minutes is the period the fee is consideration for, and he held for 130 seconds.

Rider's POL-NS-04 argument: that clause does not apply and is not needed. The driver placed an answered 22-second in-app call at 08:11:00, recorded in the trip record, which defeats the silence limb; and the chat log holds zero messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count 0. The refund rests on the dwell shortfall, not on exoneration under POL-NS-04.

No driver compensation: POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01 fails at limb (c) and POL-NS-06 states expressly that on a shortfall no driver compensation is payable. The anti-farming guard is never reached.

No escalation is warranted. There is no POL-NS-08(a) to (d) impairment — the trace is 100 percent covered with no gaps longer than the cadence and 45 driver fixes, the chat log's zero messages are consistent with the trip record, and the fare line reconciles. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is not below the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence; the profiles show no repeat dispute between these parties; and the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d of 1, far below the threshold of 4). The only MISSING artifact, the traffic advisory, carries no fact this ruling depends on.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this dispute is over the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00603, and the fee is refunded to the rider in full (SGD 4.00).

Why, in figures. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four of its conditions hold. Three of them do: the trip record logs a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:52 (limb a); the GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at 08:10:50, two seconds before that marker, with 14 qualifying fixes (limb b); and the trip was ended by the driver under the RIDER_NO_SHOW code with no boarding event (limb d). Limb (c) does not hold. For a large-venue pickup the driver must hold position inside the geofence for a continuous 300 seconds (fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The longest continuous in-geofence hold in the trace is 130 seconds, from 08:10:50 to 08:13:00 — a shortfall of 170 seconds. POL-NS-06 then fixes the consequence automatically: on a waiting-period shortfall the cancellation fee is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages. The SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in EV-FARE-00603 is therefore refunded; no other line is touched.

To the driver. Your arrival and your call are accepted. You logged the 'arrived' event, the trace puts you inside the arrival radius, you held stationary (your speeds top out at 8.8 km/h), and you placed an in-app call at 08:11:00 which the rider answered for 22 seconds. That call, and the fact that the chat log holds zero messages, means the rider's own POL-NS-04 exoneration route does not apply to her, and I have not decided the case on it. But none of that saves the fee. The fee is consideration for a full waiting period, and the trace shows you cancelled roughly two minutes into it. Your submission that the rider took 'more like five' minutes is not borne out by the record: trip_record.wait_time_min is 2.3, and the trace shows 130 seconds of dwell. Your further point — that this was an orderly RIDER_NO_SHOW cancellation and not a refused job — is accepted as a characterisation, but POL-NS-06 makes the refund turn on the numeric shortfall, not on the reason for cancelling.

To the rider. Your shortfall argument and your POL-NS-06 argument are accepted. Your account that you were close by is context only: the trace puts your device 32.6–40.6 m from the pin across 17 qualifying fixes, inside the 150 m radius, but the refund follows from the dwell shortfall alone, not from your proximity.

No driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (c) fails, and POL-NS-06 expressly provides that on a shortfall no driver compensation is payable. The anti-farming guard is never reached; in any event driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, far below the threshold of 4.

Evidence and confidence. The deciding dwell figure is carried by EV-GPS-00603 (weight_multiplier 1.0; 100% coverage, 45 fixes, max gap 0 s) and corroborated by EV-TRIP-00603 (weight_multiplier 1.0). Both are unimpaired under POL-NS-08 (no clock skew, no trace gap, chat count consistent, fare line reconciles), so the confidence cap is 1.0, above the 0.70 floor. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00603-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it cannot be used to extend the waiting clock under POL-NS-06(i), and in any case the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to add. The charge itself is arithmetically correct and is not the problem: SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), matching fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires, and no clause produces a referral.
